title: Backwards Window
description: A report where the end date comes before the start date is a contradiction that shouldn't be allowed to silently return an empty (or worse, nonsensical) result.
successCondition: GET /api/reporting/summary as a dispatcher with from set to a later date than to (e.g. from=2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z&to=2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z) returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR referencing the to field.
hints: The reportQuerySchema's refine check requires from to be strictly before to — this applies identically to both GET /summary and POST /jobs since they share the same schema.
Try from exactly equal to to as a related boundary case — the strict less-than should reject that too.
